title: Qlik NPrinting Report Delivery Failures
dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), QRS API task/audit (`qlik:qrs`), and Qlik Cloud events.
app: Qlik Sense logs via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Repository Service (QRS) API and Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC scripted inputs; QlikView/NPrinting event logs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:scheduler source="*nprinting*" (status="Failed" OR result="Error")
| stats count as failures by report_name, recipient_group
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Tracks Qlik NPrinting report generation and distribution failures so scheduled Excel/PDF/PowerPoint deliveries to stakeholders do not silently stop.
value: NPrinting feeds board packs and regulatory reports; delivery failures must be caught before a stakeholder notices a missing report.
implementation: Ingest NPrinting engine logs; schedule hourly and alert on delivery failures for compliance report groups.
visualization: Table of report by failures and recipient group.
grandmaExplanation: We make sure the scheduled Qlik reports actually reach the people expecting them each morning.
